title: Wall-Mounted Hose & Cord Holders – 5-Pack for Garage & Garden
descriptionHtml:
Hoses and cords in one big mess?

The garden hose, the extension cord and the chargers end up in a tangled heap on the garage floor. You trip, search and pull the wrong end – and everything wears out early.

Hang it all up – get order right away

The sturdy, wall-mounted holders keep hoses, cords and ropes neatly hung and easy to reach. A non-slip surface and an adjustable strap keep everything in place – in the garage, the workshop or on the patio wall.

Features

  • 5 holders – organize the whole garage.
  • Sturdy & adjustable – for hose, cord and rope.
  • Non-slip surface – everything stays put.
  • Easy wall mounting.

Right to change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
